changes.title: New maps added
changes.description: Added vsh_chemical_v1, vsh_farm_feud_rc2_panda, vsh_leak, vsh_north_mountain_pb_panda and vsh_portal_v2.

changes.title: The Blitzkrieg
changes.description: The Panda FF2 removal proposal for The Blitzkrieg was marked completed, removing the boss from the active roster.

changes.title: Hatsune Miku
changes.description: The Hatsune Miku re-suggestion was marked completed. The published design uses Scout movement, a Saxxy, Super Jump and a DCP-based ability system.

changes.title: Cirno
changes.description: The dedicated Cirno removal vote was marked completed in the Panda FF2 archive.

changes.title: Foxy
changes.description: The proposal to remove Foxy was marked completed. The thread described the boss as underplayed, underpowered and in need of a larger rework.

changes.title: Saxton Hale
changes.description: Saxton Hale received a VScript VSH-inspired rework. The published rework replaces the old ability set and includes Brave Jump and Mighty Slam.

changes.title: Spell system
changes.description: The FF2 proposal to remove the recently enabled spell system was marked completed.

changes.title: Easter Bunny
changes.description: The proposal to bring Easter Bunny back to the FF2 boss roster was marked completed.

changes.title: Vaccinator
changes.description: The recent Vaccinator rework was reverted. The sticky Current FF2 Weapon Changes thread remains the authority for the exact live setup.

changes.title: Blightcaller
changes.description: A rework that brought back the older Blightcaller concept with revised abilities was marked completed.

changes.title: Canonical weapon balance reference
changes.description: Panda's sticky Current FF2 Weapon Changes thread is the canonical reference for live weapon modifications. This site should mirror that thread instead of treating old suggestions as current balance.

changes.title: FF2 Rewrite migration
changes.description: Panda approved moving to FF2 Rewrite, bringing improved stability, a reworked boss-selection system, updated duo handling, a new HUD and integrated custom weapon-attribute support.
